# evroc_compute_profiles (Data Source)

Lists all available VM compute profiles (sizes) in the evroc platform. Exposes both lists and individual named attributes for easy reference.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `a1a_2xl` (String) General-purpose 2x-large (a1a.2xl) profile.
- `a1a_l` (String) General-purpose large (a1a.l) profile.
- `a1a_m` (String) General-purpose medium (a1a.m) profile.
- `a1a_s` (String) General-purpose small (a1a.s) profile.
- `a1a_xl` (String) General-purpose extra-large (a1a.xl) profile.
- `a1a_xs` (String) General-purpose extra-small (a1a.xs) profile.
- `c1a_2xl` (String) Compute-optimized 2x-large (c1a.2xl) profile.
- `c1a_l` (String) Compute-optimized large (c1a.l) profile.
- `c1a_m` (String) Compute-optimized medium (c1a.m) profile.
- `c1a_s` (String) Compute-optimized small (c1a.s) profile.
- `c1a_xl` (String) Compute-optimized extra-large (c1a.xl) profile.
- `gn_b200_l` (String) NVIDIA B200 GPU large (gn-b200.l) profile.
- `gn_b200_m` (String) NVIDIA B200 GPU medium (gn-b200.m) profile.
- `gn_b200_s` (String) NVIDIA B200 GPU small (gn-b200.s) profile.
- `gn_b200_xl` (String) NVIDIA B200 GPU extra-large (gn-b200.xl) profile.
- `gn_l40s_l` (String) NVIDIA L40S GPU large (gn-l40s.l) profile.
- `gn_l40s_m` (String) NVIDIA L40S GPU medium (gn-l40s.m) profile.
- `gn_l40s_s` (String) NVIDIA L40S GPU small (gn-l40s.s) profile.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `m1a_l` (String) Memory-optimized large (m1a.l) profile.
- `m1a_m` (String) Memory-optimized medium (m1a.m) profile.
- `m1a_s` (String) Memory-optimized small (m1a.s) profile.
- `m1a_xl` (String) Memory-optimized extra-large (m1a.xl) profile.
- `profiles` (List of String) List of all available compute profile names.
- `series` (List of Object) Compute profile series with descriptions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--series))
